UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile synchronized from Google Sign-In.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the header workspace account chip.

email.description: Verified email address of the authenticated user.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar image URL from Google Auth.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sign-in.

UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: User workspace preferences including ordered secondary navigation tabs.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the preference owner.

navButtonOrder.description: Ordered sequence of primary and secondary workspace navigation view IDs.

preferredIndustry.description: Last active industry key selected by the user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest preference update.

UserIndustrySnapshot.title: UserIndustrySnapshot
UserIndustrySnapshot.description: User-customized 5-pillar knowledge base and OKR studio edits for a specific industry.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the snapshot owner.

knowledgeBase.description: Native list of up to 5 KnowledgeBasePillar maps updated by RAG ingestion.

organisationalPrerequisites.description: Optional list of up to 40 configured Organisational/Industry Pre-Requisites items grounding AI agents.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the snapshot was last saved.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Multi-turn Gemini executive strategy chatbot conversation session.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the session owner.

systemInstruction.description: System instruction guiding Gemini behavior for this session.

industryContext.description: Active industry key grounded in this session.

messageCount.description: Number of messages recorded in the subcollection.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message turn.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual turn in a Gemini multi-turn chat session.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message owner.

role.description: Speaker role in the multi-turn conversation.

model.description: Gemini model used for this turn.

/users/{userId}.description: Private authenticated user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: User workspace navigation order and industry preference settings.

/users/{userId}/industries/{industryId}.description: User-updated 5-pillar RAG knowledge base snapshots keyed by industryId.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Multi-turn Gemini AI Copilot chat sessions belonging to the user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Ordered message turns belonging to a user chat session.
